pure-announcement.rationale: Describes an open format and its loading mechanism, not a release event.

duplicate.rationale: No skills-format concept exists in this corpus yet.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The format spec and adopter list are public and linked.

durability.rationale: The SKILL.md folder format and the three-stage progressive-disclosure loading model (discovery, activation, execution) are mechanism-level content already adopted across multiple products.

actionability.rationale: A reader can author a conforming skill from what is described here.

atomicity.rationale: One concept: the Agent Skills format.
